show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/WfQbEa
show.description: Once a legendary sage seeking immortality, Anirudh is forced to reincarnate as Rahul, a poor gambler trapped in debt and humiliation. In the human world, he discovers he has a mute wife, Kajal. As his dormant powers awaken, Rahul chooses a new path: to protect her, heal her, and redeem a broken life, even if it costs him his godhood.
